transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been going on that brought you in today?

Well, I'm here because... I've been having these episodes where I just eat a lot, and afterward, I feel so gross. I get really disappointed in myself, like I should have more control over it. It gets to the point where I end up writing some pretty awful things about myself in my journal. It's just really getting to me.
After these eating episodes, do you ever try to compensate for what you've eaten by making yourself sick, using laxatives, or exercising a lot?

No, I don't do anything like that. I've never tried to make myself sick or taken laxatives. And I don't really exercise to make up for it, either. Honestly, after being on my feet cleaning buildings all day, I'm usually too tired to work out anyway. I mostly just sit there and feel terrible about what I just did.
How often do these eating episodes happen, and do they usually happen when you're alone or with other people?

Well, for the past several months, it's been happening about once a week. Usually, there's at least one night a week where I just buy way too much food after my shift and end up eating it all in one sitting. I can't really remember a time recently where it stopped for more than a week or so. 

And, um, it's always when I'm alone. I would be too embarrassed to eat like that in front of anyone else. I always make sure I'm by myself in my apartment when it happens.
When you're eating all that food in one sitting, do you feel like you can't stop yourself or control how much you're eating?

Yeah, that's pretty much exactly it. Once I start, it feels like I just keep reaching for the next thing almost automatically. Even in my head, while I’m thinking, 'Fumi, stop, you have sketches to finish,' I... I don’t actually stop. I just keep going until the food is completely gone, or until I feel too uncomfortable to eat anymore.
Do these eating episodes cause you a lot of distress or interfere with your daily life, like your work or relationships?

It definitely causes me a lot of distress, yeah. I mean, I still make it to my cleaning shifts, and I still go to my design events, so it hasn't completely stopped me from doing things. But... the next day, I just feel really distracted and ashamed about it all. Sometimes I even put off my sketching because I don't want to open my journal and look at the entries I wrote right after I ate everything. It just makes me feel awful.
During these eating episodes, do you find yourself eating much more rapidly than usual?

Yeah, I do. I eat really fast during those times. Usually I'm just standing there at the kitchen counter, or sometimes I'm sitting on my bed with my sketchbook still open next to me. I'm eating so quickly that I barely even taste what I'm having. It's like I'm just trying to get it all down as fast as I can before I have a chance to really think too much about what I'm doing.
Do you eat alone during these episodes because you feel embarrassed about how much you're eating?

Not really. I mean, I live by myself, so I'm usually alone anyway when I get home from my cleaning shifts. I haven't really noticed if I'm doing it specifically to hide from anyone... it just kind of happens when I'm already by myself in my apartment.
During these eating episodes, do you find yourself eating until you feel uncomfortably full?

Not really, no. I mean, I know I'm eating a lot at once, but... I don't usually get to the point where my stomach hurts or I feel sick from it. I guess I just stop before it gets physically uncomfortable like that.
Do you ever feel like you completely lose control while eating during these episodes, like you can't stop eating or walk away from the food no matter how hard you try?

Yeah, I do. Once I start, it's like... I just keep reaching for the next thing, almost automatically. I'll even be thinking to myself, "Fumi, stop, you have sketches to finish," but I don't actually stop. I just keep going until the food is gone or I just can't eat anymore. It really does feel like I can't control it.
After these eating episodes, do you feel intense guilt, shame, or distress about what you've eaten or how much you ate?

Yeah, I really do. Honestly, that's a big part of why I decided to come in. After it happens, I just feel so gross and... disappointed in myself. I keep thinking that I should have more control over what I'm doing. It gets to the point where I end up writing really awful things about myself in my journal because I'm just so upset that I did it again.
Do you feel upset about the shape or size of your body, especially after these eating episodes?

No, not really. I don't think about my weight or my shape all that much, to be honest. Like, my body is just my body. When I get upset after eating, it's really just about the fact that I couldn't stop myself and that I did it again. It's not really because I'm worried about getting bigger or how I look in the mirror.
Have you ever had episodes where you eat a very large amount of food in a short period of time, even when you're not physically hungry, and feel really upset about it afterward?

Yeah, definitely. A lot of the time I'm not even hungry when it happens. Like, I might have already eaten a full meal after I get home from work. But... if I'm just really tired from my shift, or if I'm stuck on a design idea for my sketches, I'll just start opening snacks. And then I just keep going, even though my stomach isn't empty at all. And yeah, like I was saying before, I get really upset with myself after I do it.
Would you say that, on average, these eating episodes happen at least once a week and have been going on like this for the past three months or more?

Yeah, I would say so. For the past several months, it's been pretty consistent. Usually, there's at least one night a week where I end up buying way too much food on my way home from work and just... eating it all in one stretch. I really can't remember a recent month where it stopped for more than a week or so. It's just been happening regularly for a while now.
